name: Legume Rotation Effects on Subsequent Crop Yield
description: Global meta-analysis of yield advantages from legume-based rotations. Based on Zhao et al. 2022 (PNAS). Dataset has 11,768 observations with pre-computed effect sizes (response ratios) but NO raw treatment/control means or variance values. NO study/paper identifiers (author, year, DOI) in the dataset.
intervention: Legume rotation (growing legume as pre-crop before the subsequent crop)
control: Non-legume rotation or continuous cropping (no legume pre-crop)
important_moderators: Pre-crop legume species (PreEff: soybean, pea, alfalfa, faba bean, etc.)
Subsequent crop species (SubEff: wheat, maize, barley, sorghum, etc.)
Main crop type (grain, oilseed, root, forage, cotton, sugar)
Legume purpose (PreLegPur: Seed, Green manure, Forage)
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract yield data for BOTH legume rotation AND non-legume control treatments
2. Control = continuous cropping or non-legume rotation; Treatment = legume pre-crop rotation
3. Get variance (SE/SD/LSD) and sample size (n/replicates) for each treatment
4. Record legume species, subsequent crop, and management practices
5. Calculate response ratio (RR = treatment yield / control yield)
tc_confusion_warnings: Control is the NON-LEGUME rotation (e.g., fallow, cereal-cereal)
Treatment is the LEGUME rotation (e.g., soybean-wheat, pea-maize)
Some papers test multiple legume species - extract each vs same control
Watch for units (kg/ha vs t/ha vs g/plant)
Multi-year studies may report each year separately

ground_truth.reference: Zhao et al. 2022, PNAS (legume rotation yield advantage)
ground_truth.total_studies: UNKNOWN - no study identifiers in dataset
gt_limitations: NO raw treatment/control means - only pre-computed response ratios
NO author/year/DOI columns - cannot match to individual papers
NO SD/SE columns - only sampling variance of lnRR (vi)
Validation would require effect-size-level matching, not observation-level
Would need the original paper's reference list to identify source studies
ground_truth.subsample_strategy: Not applicable without study identifiers; would need paper reference list
